messages:
jamie: quick follow-up from the kernel-selection RFC — we need a concrete probe contract for SM capability gating across A100/H100/L4. proposal below.

jamie: probe should be idempotent, fast (<2ms), non-blocking, return {sm_features, max_warp_size, fp_types_supported, l2_size_est}

jamie: sketch:
```
// probe request
probe(device_id)
// reply
{ "sm_level":80, "wmma":true, "fp16_fp32_mix":true, "tensor_ops": {"amx":false}, "kernel_variant_hint":"fused_attn_fast" }
```

sasha: LGTM but L4 reports are noisy with older drivers :( we need driver_version + checksum in reply, or at least a driver-staleness flag.
sasha: also we should avoid heavy device queries at startup — do lazy probe on first route. :thinking:

miguel: +1 lazy probe. For A100/H100 we can include perf counters to decide between cuBLAS matmul vs fused attention kernels. metric: peak_sustained_tflops_est

anika: question: how do we encode fallback guarantees? i.e., if probe false, do we route to generic-kernel or quantized-kernel? what about precision fallbacks?

jamie: fallback policy proposal: capability=false -> route to compat-kernel (safe, generic). capability=true -> choose fastest variant. provide per-tenant override and opt-in beta for aggressive variants.

ryan: can we add telemetry tags: kernel_hint, probe_hash, chosen_variant, latency_ms, seq_len_bucket? need for RCA + cost calc.

ops-bot: deploy-note: when we flip gating we should run canary in us-west1 with 5% traffic for 12h, track p95 latency and error-rate. auto-roll-back if error-rate > 0.5% or p95 regresses >10%.

sasha: concerning L4, fused kernels degrade for seq_len < 16. add sequence-length threshold to the hint (eg: "fused_attn_fast:seq>=16").

miguel: implementation note: runtime will maintain capability_cache with TTL 24h, and on mismatch re-probe async. cache keys: device_id + driver_hash + firmware_ver. Also include an evict-on-error policy.

anika: interface nit: return string enum for variants rather than booleans — easier to extend ("compat", "optimized_fp16", "quantized_int8").

jamie: agreed. minor: probe should include a small microbenchmark hash to detect degraded HW (thermal throttling effect) — duration < 0.5ms, single tiny kernel.

ryan: i'll add telemetry + export probe results to BigQuery/debuglog for correlating perf with model configs. can we include probe_version in payload for future parsing?

jamie: next steps: write probe proto, add unit tests (driver-mock + emu), update routing-policy in canary config. who picks it up?

sasha: i'll own probe proto + driver compatibility matrix. will start a PR with test fixtures.

miguel: i'll add runtime cache + heuristics and sequence-length buckets. will mock L4 corner cases.

ryan: i'll provision the canary dashboard and alerts, and hook telemetry tags.

anika: i'll review the proto and test plan, + make sure fallback semantics are documented for product.

jamie: thanks all — i'll update the RFC with the concrete contract, rollout checklist, and telemetry schema. :thumbsup:
